title: Eventual three-term splitting of the localized weighted blow-up integral along C ⊆ M (parent Step 4)
statement:
Let Q, n ∈ ℕ. Let M, C ⊆ ℝ^Q be Hⁿ-null-measurable (Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^Q) with C ⊆ M. Let θ : ℝ^Q → ℝ, y ∈ ℝ^Q and φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ), and write η_t(x) = blowUpMap y t x = t⁻¹(x − y). Suppose there is r > 0 with Hⁿ(C ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ and θ Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_r(y). Then for all sufficiently small t > 0 (eventually in 𝓝[>] 0):
 ∫_M φ(η_t(x)) θ(x) dHⁿ(x) = θ(y) · ∫_C φ(η_t(x)) dHⁿ(x) + ∫_C φ(η_t(x)) (θ(x) − θ(y)) dHⁿ(x) + ∫_{M∖C} φ(η_t(x)) θ(x) dHⁿ(x)
(Bochner set integrals).
